deficiency.overview: Beta-carotene intake alone does not diagnose vitamin A deficiency.

excess.overview: High-dose beta-carotene supplements increase risk in smokers, former smokers and asbestos-exposed people.
excess.medicalBoundary: No upper limit is an intake goal. Seek professional or medical advice before changing supplement or medication use.
